root_cause.why_it_is_not_merely_a_test_problem: calib.domain_balanced@v1 is the fixed distribution every probe is measured under, and BOTH identities are bound into this session's authorization (calibration_profile_hashes, calibration_content_hashes) and its preregistration. The session asserts the mixtures identify it while never staging their bytes. The test gate stopped it at $0.2513; the next failure point would have been a probe stage, far more expensive.
root_cause.class: the same inheritance defect as the product contract repaired earlier today: the continuation was derived from Phase B's launcher and took some declarations from Phase A instead. Reasoning from what the session NEEDED rather than what the machinery REQUIRES.
root_cause.not_caused_by: the product-contract repair. Both omissions predate it; the previous attempt never reached a pod because ckpt_store_capacity_gate refused first.
